_note: Security-cam position matching TEST_CAMERAS['G'] from sim_utils/test_cameras.py. IRA places the camera at (x, y, height) with Euler (yaw, pitch). Since IRA auto-aims cameras at characters (aim_cameras_at_characters=true by default), the yaw/pitch are overridden at runtime and the camera tracks Character_0. If you want fixed pose, set /persistent/exts/isaacsim.replicator.agent/aim_cameras_at_characters=false before run.
